text:
Noah Turner: FYI LedgerFlow renewal landed in AP as an Enterprise seat bundle but our account has always been API-first. Invoice INV-LF-07 shows 25 seats + 500k included calls/month which is not what we use. Can someone review?

Sofia Patel: Upload the invoice? I'll pull our usage.

Noah Turner: PDF: https://files.redwood/procurement/ledgerflow_inv_july.pdf — summary: List $210k/yr (25 seats + 500k/mo), onboarding $12k, overage $0.003/call.

Sofia Patel: Our last 3 months: Apr 2026 1.2M, May 2026 1.05M, Jun 2026 1.15M. That's ~13.8M/yr. 500k/mo = 6M/yr included, so ~8M over. If overage $0.003 that's ~24k/yr extra, but seat pricing drives to $210k which is absurd for pure API.

Ethan (LedgerFlow Sales): Hi Noah/Sofia 1 thanks for the heads up. Apologies 1 system defaulted to seat bundle for renewals. We can switch to committed consumption. Quick options: (A) 8M calls/yr at $0.0028/call + admin seats $3k = $25,400/yr; (B) 12M calls/yr at $0.0023/call + seats $5k = $31,600/yr. Both waive onboarding for pilots and include monthly reporting.

Marta (Finance): Those numbers look much closer to expectation. Procurement note: any commit > $25k/yr needs FinanceOps approval. We'll need a clear invoice showing math for AP.

Noah Turner: Procurement asks before we accept: 1) Written 12-month price lock for committed rate, 2) Explicit monthly overage cap in USD (prefer $4k/mo), 3) Pilot termination rights (60 days), 4) Net30 payment, 5) DPA + SOC2 attestation, 6) Invoice that line-items committed math.

Ethan (LedgerFlow Sales): Agreed on all points except I need to confirm the exact overage cap. I can offer $4k/mo cap for the first 6 months or a first-year cap of $48k. Which do you prefer?

Sofia Patel: First-year cap of $48k is fine, but put it in the SOW as a dollar cap for year 1. Also request a clause that if monthly avg exceeds commit by >125% for 3 months we renegotiate rates.

Marta (Finance): Add to procurement checklist: include explicit PO terms and show a breakdown so AP doesn't code it wrong. Also request an account credit for the billing error that caused the seat bundle invoice.

ProcureBot: Reminder: approval threshold: commits > $25k/yr route to FinanceOps; commits > $50k/yr require VP Finance sign-off. See https://intra.redwood/finance/vendor-commits.

Noah Turner: Can you also ask LedgerFlow to confirm retention/deletion window for logs and whether they use subprocessors for analytics? Legal will need that in the DPA.

Ethan (LedgerFlow Sales): Will include data retention 30 days by default, deletion within 30 days of termination, and list of subprocessors in the DPA. I'll draft a counter and corrected invoice showing "Committed Consumption - 12M calls @ $0.0023 = $27,600 + seats $5,000 = $32,600" and attach a redline.

Sofia Patel: Paste quick usage snippet we'll include in the counter email so they see the pattern:
```
month,api_calls
2026-04,1200000
2026-05,1050000
2026-06,1150000
```

Noah Turner: Draft subject: "LedgerFlow renewal - request for committed consumption pricing, first-year overage cap, and invoice correction (Redwood Inference)". Post the draft here when ready and we'll thumbs-up before sending to vendor.

Ethan (LedgerFlow Sales): I'll post the redline and corrected invoice within the hour: https://docs.redwood/contracts/ledgerflow-counter-07.md. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marta (Finance): Once redline is in Legal/Procurement I'll route to FinanceOps for approval. If we go with the 12M commit it's under the $50k VP threshold but needs FinanceOps review.

Sofia Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick review once counter posted and then I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
